scope: Independent individual counterfactual forecasts using the unchanged personas and realism principles. No actual visitor, purchase, personal output or repeated-day experiment was performed. The original historical JSONL schema/results were not overwritten.
newGroundTruth: Root supplied current integration state: account-first quiz with contact and experience, owner/generation-bound handoff being fixed, separate fact/variant/schedule stages; v34 hosted recurring three cadences; six live-read employer boards; source-bound Deep Tailor focused tests; subscription checkout mapping unfinished; no industry/visa filters; zero actual fourteen-day observations.
handoffAssumption: Forecasts assume the promised handoff correction and removal of beta/pilot labels are included in the final deployment. They do not penalise the corrected old generic Today landing as an ongoing defect. Final browser/deployed evidence is still required.
interpretation: recommendation_0_to_10 is a forecast recommendation score, not measured customer NPS. would_pay_recurring and very_disappointed are judgments, not transactions or survey answers. Conditional is never counted as paid or very disappointed. Country is not inferred work authorisation.
